subject: Analytics at Maple Freight
body:
Hi Leo,

I saw that Maple Freight is building an analytics team. Growing teams usually need people who can turn data into decisions.

At Tidewater Freight I built reporting and forecasting, and RTO fell from 18% to 13% over two quarters. I think that experience could help your team as it grows.

Would a 15 minute call next week be useful? If someone else owns this hire, a name is plenty.

Thanks,
